notes.title: 0.6 is here!
notes.content:
Hello again!

let's see:
[list]
    [*]First I remade the entire bullets system, their hit detection is almost perfect now, they move faster and and are more predictable.
    [*]Then I fixed the whole torpedo situation, in the previous version they started to act weird being launched in weird directions and whatnot.
    [*]And last but definitely not least, I was informed that the train encounter was absolutely borked, and indeed it was (thanks Steaz for the feedback), it's fixed now.
[/list] 
Oh, and this is something that will need to be added in the game, but, just so you guys know, torpedoes are manually detonated, so after you click for it to launch, click again to make it go boom ;)

Also, here's a discord server for you people to drop by and say hi:
https://discord.gg/RjtsquT

notes.title: Hello World! v0.5.1 is here
notes.content:
Hi there!

Fist week(almost) in Steam's early access and i'm already getting some useful feedback!

[b]Thanks[/b] everyone who checked the game out, specially [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MsowUnIdhxY] This Guy [/url] for 
giving me some feedback about the early segment of the game with his first impressions video thingy, and i've been busy fixing most of the problems.
Here's a list of what v0.5.1 changes:
[list]
    [*]fixed: the weird sound of the cars in the jump scene (intro)
    [*]fixed: base's columns have working "target" indicators now
    [*]"basic vehicle" and "fighter" drift much less, should be controllable now
    [*]enemies from the first area shoot less often.
    [*]enemies from the first, second, and third area have less HP (40%, 60% 80% respectively).
    [*]softer thunder SFX (intro) ;)
[/list]

i hope that fixes most of the problems with the early segment from the game :D

have fun.
